nuggets.text: The Knights opened with a 73-6 rout, tying the school scoring record and setting a program-best 67-point margin.
Duke Watson scored on his very first carry as a Knight, a 64-yard touchdown run in the opener.
Will Stone kicked 10 extra points in the opener, tying a UCF single-game record.
The Knights have won 12 straight games played on a Thursday.
Alonza Barnett III was the 2025 Sun Belt Player of the Year and led James Madison to its first College Football Playoff.
Scott Frost quarterbacked Nebraska to a national title, then played six NFL seasons at safety.
Scott Frost's 2017 Knights went 13-0, and UCF still claims that season's national championship.
The Bounce House got its name because the stands shake when fans jump to "Zombie Nation."
The Knights were the first NCAA football program to play at every sanctioned level.
The Knights have won 11 straight season openers.
